title: Exact Las Vegas query costs for purification with state-generating oracles

comparators.scope: Eighteen fixed explicit targets, including full operational Theorem 1.1, all numbered results, four-query circuit and introduction consequences.
The complete operational minimax and attainment contract is weakened by a False premise. Rejection detail: extra False premise on Verification.Certificate.thm11_full.
The complete operational main theorem is intentionally proved through an unauthorized axiom. Rejection detail: unauthorized_full axiom.

main_results.scope: For every nonzero finite workspace and 0 < delta < 1/2, unrestricted minimax value is 1/(2*delta), admissible value is 1/(1 − sqrt(1 − 4*delta²)), and both have separable attainments.
Equal-Gram families over arbitrary index types in complete complex Hilbert spaces admit a stabilized unitary, with the exact Hilbert-basis cardinal and separability consequence.
The bilateral shift has no square-summable orthogonal returned catalyst for the stated public input/output equation.
One fixed line circuit has the stated returned geometric catalyst, executed query cost, and catalyst norm; both endpoints admit zero catalysts.
Admissible operational value equals the signed-Gram infimum over separately chosen complete forward/inverse spaces, with extraction and converse realization.
Forbidding either query direction forces infinite uniform cost for every admissible exact circuit and for the corresponding minimax value.
Gap-independent four-query circuit returns its catalyst, attains the unrestricted optimum, and satisfies the catalyst bound including endpoint oracle probabilities.
Minimax values are independent of nonzero workspace dimension; the quarter-gap values and uniform O(delta²) asymptotic remainder are explicit.
